The '''Salgarus system''' was a part of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the origin point of<ref name="Planetnamia" /> [[Salgari street kid]]s.<ref name="501st" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Salgarus [[Star system/Legends|system]] was mentioned in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-9.<ref name="EAOC" />
